discoveries: After `inline *`, the only difference between the two sides is the right side's `if (CCA_KEM.b) { k1 <$ dbits_dkeyl }`. The invariant fixes `CCA_KEM.b{2} = false`, so `rcondf{2}` removes that branch once the `sp` steps bring it to the front.
